title: Weed and Dreams
content: Does anyone here smoke weed? I’ve been a daily user for about 10 years, recently I decided to give up smoking for health reasons. I’ve noticed less intense dreams and it’s kind of harder to remember them as well. I felt like when I smoked before bed I would wake up during the middle of my dream, if that makes sense, so it was easier to recall them. I’ve heard smoking weed actually makes it harder to remember dreams, or makes dreams less vivid, but I think I have the opposite experience. Can anyone relate? Or maybe a different substance, like alcohol, has impacted your dreams?
